title: GAIDE-Trace event record
description: One line of .gaide-trace/events/<session_id>.jsonl. Empty fields are omitted.

event.description: Canonical, tool-agnostic event name. v0.2 stores used Claude Code hook names (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse, ...); readers and the server normalize them on read via the same mapping adapters use on write.

native_event.description: Event name in the source tool's own vocabulary (e.g. PostToolUse for Claude Code, step.15 for Antigravity)

prompt_id.description: Groups all events of one user turn

project.description: Project name (GAIDE_TRACE_PROJECT, store config, or basename of cwd)

agent_id.description: Present when the event came from a subagent

transcript_path.description: Path of the source tool's live transcript at capture time, when it has one

origin.description: Server-side only: name of the API key that shipped the record
